judgment.explanation: The binomial coefficient n choose k is defined as the number of ways to choose k elements from a set of n distinct elements. By definition, choosing none elements (0 elements) from a set is exactly one way (the empty set), hence n choose 0 equals 1. Similarly, choosing all elements (n elements) from a set is exactly one way (the set itself), hence n choose n equals 1.
